# Combobox

> Searchable single-select with input and floating option list.

This file matches the installed `combobox` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/combobox.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/combobox.md`.

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Composition

### Searchable list

ComboboxInput includes its trigger by default.

```tsx
<Combobox>
  <ComboboxInput />
  <ComboboxContent>
    <ComboboxEmpty />
    <ComboboxList>
      <ComboboxGroup>
        <ComboboxGroupLabel />
        <ComboboxItem />
      </ComboboxGroup>
    </ComboboxList>
  </ComboboxContent>
</Combobox>
```

### Leading addon

Inside ComboboxInputGroup, ComboboxInput drops its own field surface and moves its trigger to a trailing addon; the popup still aligns to the whole group.

```tsx
<Combobox>
  <ComboboxInputGroup>
    <InputGroupAddon />
    <ComboboxInput />
  </ComboboxInputGroup>
  <ComboboxContent>
    <ComboboxList>
      <ComboboxItem />
    </ComboboxList>
  </ComboboxContent>
</Combobox>
```

### Standalone trigger

```tsx
<Combobox>
  <ComboboxTrigger />
  <ComboboxContent>
    <ComboboxList>
      <ComboboxItem />
    </ComboboxList>
  </ComboboxContent>
</Combobox>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

import { Combobox, ComboboxContent, ComboboxEmpty, ComboboxInput, ComboboxItem, ComboboxList } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/combobox";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

interface Framework {
  value: string;
  label: string;
}

const FRAMEWORKS: Framework[] = [
  { value: "next", label: "Next.js" },
  { value: "remix", label: "Remix" },
  { value: "astro", label: "Astro" },
  { value: "nuxt", label: "Nuxt" },
  { value: "sveltekit", label: "SvelteKit" },
  { value: "solidstart", label: "SolidStart" },
  { value: "tanstack", label: "TanStack Start" },
  { value: "gatsby", label: "Gatsby" },
];

export function PrimitiveComboboxExample() {
  const [framework, setFramework] = useState<Framework | null>(FRAMEWORKS[0] ?? null);

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-2">
      <Text size="caption" weight="medium" tone="muted">
        Framework
      </Text>
      <Combobox items={FRAMEWORKS} value={framework} onValueChange={setFramework}>
        <ComboboxInput placeholder="Search framework…" aria-label="Framework" />
        <ComboboxContent>
          <ComboboxEmpty>No framework found.</ComboboxEmpty>
          <ComboboxList>
            {(item: Framework) => (
              <ComboboxItem key={item.value} value={item}>
                {item.label}
              </ComboboxItem>
            )}
          </ComboboxList>
        </ComboboxContent>
      </Combobox>
      <Text size="caption" tone="muted">
        {framework ? `Selected: ${framework.label}` : "Nothing selected"}
      </Text>
      <RepositorySearchExample />
    </div>
  );
}

const repositories = [
  { name: "Control UI", slug: "ctrl-ui", owner: "acme" },
  { name: "Reflet", slug: "reflet", owner: "team" },
];

function RepositorySearchExample() {
  const [repository, setRepository] = useState<(typeof repositories)[number] | null>(null);

  return (
    <fieldset aria-label="Repository search" className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-2">
      <Combobox
        items={repositories}
        value={repository}
        onValueChange={setRepository}
        itemToStringLabel={(item) => item.name}
        filter={(item, query) => `${item.owner}/${item.slug} ${item.name}`.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())}
      >
        <ComboboxInput aria-label="Repository" placeholder="Search by name, slug, or owner…" />
        <ComboboxContent>
          <ComboboxEmpty>No repository found.</ComboboxEmpty>
          <ComboboxList<(typeof repositories)[number]>>
            {(item) => (
              <ComboboxItem key={item.slug} value={item}>
                {item.name}
              </ComboboxItem>
            )}
          </ComboboxList>
        </ComboboxContent>
      </Combobox>
      <Text size="caption" tone="muted" role="status">
        {repository ? `Selected repository: ${repository.name}` : "No repository selected"}
      </Text>
    </fieldset>
  );
}
```
